executive_summary: Maven build failed with 45 compilation errors due to missing dependencies. The project code references Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang libraries, but these dependencies are not declared in pom.xml. All errors are dependency-related and can be resolved by adding the required dependencies to the Maven configuration.

errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. The SecurityConfig class attempts to use Spring Security annotations and classes, but the spring-boot-starter-security dependency is not declared.
Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. Repository interfaces extend JpaRepository and use Spring Data JPA annotations, but the spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency is not declared.

Jakarta Persistence API is missing. Entity classes use JPA annotations like @Entity, @Table, @Id, but the jakarta.persistence-api dependency is not declared. This is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is added to pom.xml (includes Jakarta Persistence API). If already added, verify Spring Boot version compatibility.

errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 library is missing from pom.xml. The ValidationUtils class attempts to use Commons Lang3 utilities, but the commons-lang3 dependency is not declared.
